answer: A copied observer badge cannot reopen the same slit night. Before dawn I escrow 33.8 POA on pier PR-5, bolt a fresh 2.4 m copper ground strap to dome D-2, and tear page 118 from the atlas binder as the one-shot pointing ticket. The slit motor arms only if the torn-page hash, strap resistance (0.41-0.47 ohm), and a 14-minute pier tilt log all match. If the page is still intact, resistance walks 0.08 ohm, or a second badge tries the same right-ascension row, the slit stays sealed and 16.9 POA is slashed.
